verdict.rationale: Omnara is explicitly positioned as open-source (Apache 2.0) and 'free to self-host and build on,' with a public GitHub repo and self-hosted deployment details (e.g., querying Postgres directly for analytics) confirming the capability exists in practice, not just marketing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on report of someone actually self-hosting and confirming setup ease or parity with the hosted SaaS version.
